♡Family Today♡

Warm today, 77, and then the weather turns overnight — showers and a rumble of thunder after eleven, more before dawn. Bills host Detroit Thursday at 8:15. Buffalo is a two-to-one favorite, which is a strange sentence to write about a Thursday game against Detroit.
  • Sep 17Bills host Detroit — Thursday night, 8:15
  • Sep 26Harvest Moon, full at 12:48 p.m.
  • Nov 3Election Day
Had a migraine? Say so in the group chat — the day and roughly when — and the paper will mark it on the Barograph. Enough entries and we will know what the glass does before one hits.

☾The Almanac Sky☾

Next new moon Sat, Oct 10 · Harvest Moon Sat, Sep 26
Tonight Saturn rises in the east at 8:13 and is up all night. Jupiter comes up at 3:45 a.m. Clouds thicken after dark tonight, so the early evening is the window — Venus low in the west until 8:26, then the crescent until a bit after nine.

☰The Barograph · 14120☰

Moderate · 31/100
30.26″
↑ high, flattening out
Topped out, no headache 30.26 this morning, up another eleven hundredths but the climb has flattened. Yesterday's jump was the sharpest in the log and it came and went without an episode, which is the first evidence against the pattern the log had been showing. Tonight the rain arrives and the needle starts down again; that is the next thing to watch, not today.

✶The Ledger✶

Emmys for one comedy in one year
14
Widow's Bay, a first-season show about a cursed New England town, won fourteen Emmys between the craft ceremonies and last night — more than any comedy has ever won in a single year.

✶The National Wire✶

1

EPA Moves to Repeal Power Plant Carbon Limits

The agency is set to undo the standards governing coal and gas plants, the central climate rule of the last decade. Litigation is certain.

2

Judge: Halving FEMA's Workforce Broke the Law

A federal judge ruled the administration acted illegally in directing the cuts. The decision lands in the middle of hurricane season.

3

Ebola Cases in Congo Pass 7,000

The outbreak is now among the largest on record, and global aid cuts have thinned the response.

☑ The Ballot · 49 days to Election Day · early voting Oct 24–Nov 1 · register by Oct 24
4

Petraeus Escapes Drone Strike Near the Polish Border

The former CIA director was at a Ukrainian rail station when a Russian drone hit it. He was unhurt.

⛪The Home Wire⛪

1

North Tonawanda · The Reassessment Is Coming

The council voted 4–1 to reassess all 14,600 properties, the first citywide look since 2009, and hired GAR Associates for $550,000. The average house is assessed at $291,000 now. Commercial property may take the bigger jump: the Walmart on Niagara Falls Boulevard could go from $224,000 a year to just over a million.

2

Rochester · Fringe Opens Today

Twelve days, 715 performances, 45 venues downtown. Pete Davidson headlines the comedy; the free outdoor circus runs Friday and Saturday at Parcel 5 and Gibbs Street.

★The Marquee★

1

The Pitt Repeats

Second straight drama series win for the Pittsburgh emergency-room show, and a second straight lead actor Emmy for Noah Wyle.

2

Jean Smart Goes Five for Five

She won lead comedy actress for every season Hacks ever aired, and the fifth ties her with Allison Janney and Julia Louis-Dreyfus at eight acting Emmys apiece.

3

Colbert Wins on the Way Out

The canceled Late Show took outstanding variety series. Rhea Seehorn won her first Emmy, for Pluribus, written by Vince Gilligan.

🏈The Gridiron🏈

Two Days to Thursday Night
Bills · Detroit at Orchard Park, Thursday 8:15 on Prime. The models make Buffalo a two-to-one favorite, which says more about Detroit than it does about the Bills: the Lions needed a one-point win over New Orleans at home to open. Short week for both. Ten penalties in Houston is the thing to clean up.
Jets · Green Bay at the Meadowlands, Sunday 1:00, and the Packers are favored by two to one the other way. Green Bay lost 39–22 in Minnesota and will be irritated about it.

⚑The Chase⚑

Bristol Under the Lights
Saturday night at 7:30 on USA, race three of ten, on the half-mile concrete bullring where tire wear has decided the last several. Hamlin still leads, but Kyle Larson is twelve back and came out of Gateway with his first win in fifty-one races. Bristol has historically been good to him.

☾On This Day☾

September 15, 1916 — tanks were used in battle for the first time, at Flers-Courcelette on the Somme. Of the forty-nine sent forward, most broke down or ditched before reaching the German line.

I have four wheels, a roof, a horn and a steering wheel, and I have never once needed gas. What am I? Answer below the fold.
